html:
/* Template:PageBanner/styles.css - the picture at the top of a page. Two pictures are in the page, one for wide windows and one for narrow ones. */
.aa-banner {
	position: relative;
	overflow: hidden;
	margin: 0 0 1em;
	border-radius: 12px;
	border: 1px solid var(--aa-edge, rgba(247, 240, 233, .1));
	line-height: 0;
	background: var(--color-surface-2, #221e1b);
}
.aa-banner .aa-banner-img,
.aa-banner img {
	display: block;
	width: 100%;
	height: auto;
}
.aa-banner-pic { overflow: hidden; }
/* zoom: the picture is scaled up inside its frame (the scale is set in the template), the title does not scale */
.aa-banner-narrow { display: none; }

/* the title sits on a dark fade at the bottom so it can be read on any picture */
.aa-banner-text {
	position: absolute;
	left: 0;
	right: 0;
	bottom: 0;
	padding: 56px 22px 16px;
	line-height: 1.15;
	background: linear-gradient(to top, rgba(14, 10, 8, .78), rgba(14, 10, 8, 0));
	pointer-events: none;
}
.aa-banner-title {
	font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif;
	font-weight: 700;
	font-size: 2.2rem;
	color: #f7f0e8;
	text-shadow: 0 2px 10px rgba(0, 0, 0, .6);
}
.aa-banner-sub {
	margin-top: 2px;
	font-size: .9rem;
	letter-spacing: .08em;
	text-transform: uppercase;
	color: rgba(247, 240, 232, .8);
	text-shadow: 0 1px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, .6);
}

@media (max-width: 700px) {
	.aa-banner-wide { display: none; }
	.aa-banner-narrow { display: block; }
	.aa-banner-text { padding: 40px 14px 12px; }
	.aa-banner-title { font-size: 1.6rem; }
	.aa-banner-sub { font-size: .75rem; }
}

/* the default: the picture runs out to the outline of the content panel (top and both sides), like the News page.
   The negative margins are the padding of the panel (Citizen.css), the corners follow the panel corners. */
.aa-banner-bleed {
	margin: -24px -28px 1.2em;
	border: 0;
	border-bottom: 1px solid var(--aa-outline, rgba(226, 133, 82, .15));
	border-radius: 17px 17px 0 0;
}
@media (max-width: 999.98px) {
	.aa-banner-bleed {
		margin: -14px -16px 1em;
		border-radius: 13px 13px 0 0;
	}
}
